final_answer: The transformer architecture utilizes the self-attention mechanism to compute contextual relationships across sequential tokens efficiently. The self-attention mechanism allows the model to weigh the importance of each token in the context of the entire sequence, enabling it to capture long-range dependencies and produce contextually relevant outputs. The self-attention mechanism is a key component of transformer models, which have achieved state-of-the-art performance across domains and tasks.
